description: "My Autobiography: A Fragment" by F. Max Müller is a philosophical memoir written in the late 19th century. This autobiographical fragment provides insight into Muller's life as a scholar, particularly his thoughts on language, mythology, and religion, while offering reflections on his personal experiences and struggles as he pursued his scholarly mission.
